newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand releases sugar cane crushing schedule.
newsitem.headline: Thailand releases sugar cane crushing schedule.

text.p: The Thai Sugar Board on Wednesday released a complete sugar cane crushing schedule for the 46 mills throughout the country for the season beginning November and ending next June.
All 11 mills in the northeastern region will start crushing from November 5, it added.

But 19 mills in the central region will have different crushing schedules. A state-run mill in Suphan Buri province will start on November 25. Four others will start from December 8, another four from December 17 and the remaining 10 will start from December 23.
Ten crushing mills in the north will run their factories from December 4 and six factories in the east will start from November 20.
The schedule is usually based on weather conditions and the preparedness of the mills.

The Sugar Board's preliminary figure for sugar cane production for 1996/97 (Nov-Oct) was 60.32 million tonnes and 6.28 million tonnes tel quel for sugar output compared with 57.69 million and 6.03 million tonnes respectively for 1995/96.
